title: The most important part of Facebook Ad creative
description: The most important part of Facebook Ad creative
transcript: If you could only change one thing about your meta ad creative. Change the hook. The hook is the first three seconds, the most important part of any video ad creative. It either grabs people's attention or it doesn't. Now, since the Andromeda update, a lot of people seem to have the misconception that hooks don't matter anywhere near as much as they used to. They absolutely do. You are advertising to real people, and what grabs their attention is required to get them to watch the rest of the video ad to determine whether or not they're gonna be interested in your offer, whether or not they're gonna buy and become a lead. So don't fall into trap of thinking that hooks don't matter as much as they used to. They absolutely do.
